purpose: Ask someone not to perform an action.
keywords: Please do not park your bicycle here.
Please do not delete this photo.
restrictions: A request can still sound direct; social context matters.
mistake: Use ないでください, not なくてください.

segments.role: Ask someone not to perform an action. ない-form + でください.
